note: Every fact used in this section is stored here with the exact page it came from. Sources marked status=verified were opened and read on 2026-11-11. Sources marked status=referenced_only are cited by an official page but were not read directly; nothing in this section depends on their unread text. Quote fields are verbatim fragments where they can be matched character for character to the page; where a quote field starts with 'paraphrase:' the wording is a summary written for this site, not the page's own words.

sources.title: Bank of China e-banking service charge table (cross-border remittance)
facts: Cross-border wire (境外汇出汇款) commission 0.1% of the remitted amount, minimum CNY 50, maximum CNY 260.
Cable charge CNY 150 for destinations other than Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan; CNY 80 for Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan.

sources.title: HSBC China tariff of accounts services for personal customers (v2)
facts: Overseas telegraphic transfer (outward remittance): 0.1% of amount, minimum CNY 100, maximum CNY 500, plus cable charge CNY 120 for Premier/Advance customers.

Global Transfer to your own HSBC account abroad: free for Premier; Advance is charged CNY 145 per transaction, described in the tariff as an indication charge with the actual charge USD 20 or equivalent.
Global Transfer to Family (other individuals' HSBC accounts): free.
Private Banking individual customers: overseas remittance free.
Premier service fee CNY 300 per month unless total relationship balance is at least CNY 500,000.
International Education Payment platform: CNY 50 per transaction, indication charge with actual charge USD 7 or equivalent.
Foreign currency demand draft to overseas terminated since 1 December 2019.
Cash withdrawal of CNY 50,000 or more requires at least one working day advance notice to the call centre or branch.
Document header carries two dates (31 Oct 2026 and 2024年9月12日), so the tariff's effective date is not stated unambiguously on the page read.
sources.quote: paraphrase: Overseas Remittances | 0.1% (min CNY100, max CNY500) + cable CNY120

sources.title: Wise help: guide to CNY transfers
facts: Sending CNY out of mainland China is available to people who are not mainland-Chinese nationals, have previously worked in China and hold tax records from the last three years.
Money can only be sent to the sender's own account.
Per-transfer limits: CNY 300,000 through a bank app, CNY 50,000 through Alipay.
The overall limit is approximately salary earned in China minus tax already paid in China.
The page read does not publish a CNY to USD transfer fee.
sources.quote: paraphrase: You can send up to 300,000 CNY per transfer from a bank app, or 50,000 CNY from Alipay.

facts: China, CNY per USD yearly average: 2023 7.075, 2024 7.189, 2025 7.129.

sources.title: 汇发〔2007〕1号 个人外汇管理办法实施细则
facts: Article 2: annual foreign exchange purchase/sale facilitation quota of USD 50,000 per domestic individual.
Article 13: a foreign individual's RMB current-account income in China may be purchased for foreign exchange with identity document plus source-of-funds and tax documentation.
Articles 14-15 set remittance documentation rules for individuals.
Articles 30-31 set cash deposit and withdrawal rules for individuals.
sources.quote: paraphrase: 境内个人办理购汇业务，年度便利化额度为每人每年等值5万美元

sources.title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (State Council Decree No. 532)
facts: Article 39 (逃汇, evasion of foreign exchange controls): fine of 30% of the amount involved; where circumstances are serious, 30% to 100%.
Article 40 (非法套汇, illegal arbitrage): fine of 30% of the amount; serious cases 30% to 100%.
Article 41 (illegal conversion of foreign exchange into RMB): fine 30%; serious 30% to 100%.
Article 42 (carrying currency or securities in or out of the country in violation): warning; fine of up to 20% of the amount.
Article 45 (私buying/selling foreign exchange outside designated banks, or swapping RMB with foreign currency): warning, confiscation of illegal gains, fine of 30% of the amount; serious 30% to 100%.
Criminal liability is preserved where a violation constitutes a crime.
sources.quote: 第三十九条 有违反规定将境内外汇转移境外...处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款

sources.title: SAFE Tianjin: 境内个人购汇 / 境外个人购汇 Q&A (2026-07-13)
facts: A foreign individual buying foreign exchange from RMB income earned in China for labour remuneration follows 汇发〔2020〕14号 Article 59: identity document plus source-of-funds materials, including tax vouchers.
sources.quote: paraphrase: 境外个人...凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇

sources.title: SAFE Tianjin: 境外个人购汇 Q&A (2024-06-21)
facts: A foreign individual's PRC current-account RMB income may be purchased with identity document and source materials including tax vouchers per 汇发〔2020〕14号 Article 59.
Only holders of permanent residence status are eligible for the annual facilitation quota.
sources.quote: paraphrase: 只有取得永久居留资格的境外个人才适用年度便利化额度

sources.title: 汇发〔2014〕2号 关于进一步改进和调整资本项目外汇管理政策的通知
facts: Section VI: an emigrant's domestic property transfer requires SAFE approval; the previous staged-remittance requirement was abolished effective 2014-02-10.
sources.quote: paraphrase: 取消移民财产转移分阶段汇出的要求，自2014年2月10日起施行

sources.title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 (PBOC Announcement [2004] No.16)
sources.issuer: People's Bank of China, republished in State Council Gazette
facts: An emigrant transfer covers lawful domestic property held before the immigration status was obtained, converted and remitted through a designated bank.
Original staging: first remittance up to half; after one year up to half of the remainder; after two years the balance. A one-off transfer of up to RMB 200,000 was allowed without staging.
Approval: up to RMB 500,000 by the local SAFE branch; above RMB 500,000 by SAFE head office.
Proceeds must be wired directly to the applicant's own overseas account; cash withdrawal in China is not permitted for these transfers.
sources.quote: 申请金额在人民币50万元以下的，由所在地外汇局审批；超过人民币50万元的，报国家外汇管理局审批

sources.title: 移民财产转移购付汇核准 service guide (Hebei branch, item 000171111002)
facts: Eligibility: applicant has foreign permanent residence, foreign citizenship, or Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan resident status; funds are lawful property held before that status was obtained; funds are not restricted by judicial or supervisory authorities.
Applications of more than RMB 1,000,000 involving public officials and close relatives may trigger an inquiry to the supervisory authority.

Required documents include written application, identity documents, household-registration cancellation certificate, income-source and property-right documents, and an original tax certificate from the tax authority.
No fee is charged; acceptance within 5 working days; legal decision time 20 working days, extendable once by 10 working days.
Applications must be made on site; online filing is not supported.
sources.quote: 法定审批时限：20 个工作日 ... 办理行政许可是否收费：否

sources.title: 汇发〔2015〕49号 关于进一步完善个人外汇业务监测系统的通知
facts: Personal foreign exchange monitoring system in operation from 2016-01-01.
Borrowing or lending the annual facilitation quota, or splitting purchases to evade limits, is prohibited.
Individuals placed on the watch list (关注名单) face strict authenticity review for two years.
sources.quote: paraphrase: 对借用他人额度、分拆购汇等行为...列入关注名单，两年内严格审核

sources.title: SAFE English release: overseas cash withdrawals with domestic bank cards
facts: Overseas cash withdrawal with a domestic bank card is capped at RMB 100,000 per individual per calendar year and RMB 10,000 per day per card.
Lending or borrowing bank cards to evade the cap is prohibited; exceeding the cap results in suspension of the card's overseas cash withdrawal function for two years.
sources.quote: paraphrase: RMB 100,000 per person per year, RMB 10,000 per day per card

sources.title: 携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法 (汇发〔2003〕102号)
sources.issuer: SAFE and General Administration of Customs, State Council Gazette
facts: Carrying foreign cash out of China up to the equivalent of USD 5,000 requires no permit.
USD 5,000 to USD 10,000 requires a 携带外汇出境许可证 issued by the bank; a customs release requires the bank-stamped permit.
Carrying more than the equivalent of USD 10,000 is in principle not allowed; a SAFE-issued permit is required for listed special cases.
Where several permits together exceed USD 10,000, customs will not release the funds.
A permit is valid for one use within 30 days of issue.
Bringing in more than USD 5,000 in cash requires written customs declaration.
sources.quote: paraphrase: 出境人员原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元外币现钞出境

sources.title: 银发〔2026〕42号 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币等相关风险的通知
sources.issuer: People's Bank of China and other authorities
facts: Virtual currency related business activities are characterised as illegal financial activities and are strictly prohibited.
Virtual currency is not legal tender and has no legal status equivalent to fiat currency.
sources.quote: paraphrase: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动，一律严格禁止

sources.title: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局公告2013年第40号 (tax filing for outward payments)
facts: A single outward payment equivalent to USD 50,000 or more for service trade, income and current transfers requires tax filing (税务备案) with the competent tax authority.
Article 3(13): personal foreign exchange use for study abroad, travel and visiting relatives is exempt from the filing requirement.
The tax authority may review whether taxes on the payment have been paid and may recover tax plus penalties.
sources.quote: 境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上...均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案

sources.title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (Individual Income Tax Law)
sources.issuer: Shanghai Municipal Tax Service, State Taxation Administration
facts: Article 1: a resident individual is one domiciled in China or resident for 183 days or more in a tax year and is taxed on worldwide income.

Article 2: income categories include wages and salaries, labour remuneration, author's remuneration, royalties, business income, interest, dividends, property lease, property transfer, and incidental income.
Article 3: comprehensive income 3%-45%; business income 5%-35%; interest, dividends, property lease, property transfer and incidental income 20%.
Article 7: a credit is allowed for foreign income tax already paid on foreign-source income.
sources.quote: 居民个人...从中国境内和境外取得的所得，依照本法规定缴纳个人所得税

sources.title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
facts: An FBAR is required where the aggregate value of foreign financial accounts exceeds USD 10,000 at any time during the calendar year.
Due date 15 April, with an automatic extension to 15 October.
sources.quote: paraphrase: aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year

sources.title: 31 CFR 1010.821 - penalty adjustment for inflation
facts: For assessments on or after 2025-01-17, Table 1 of 31 CFR 1010.821 lists: 31 USC 5321(a)(1) BSA violation, minimum USD 71,545 and maximum USD 286,184.
31 USC 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) non-willful violation of a foreign financial agency transaction requirement: USD 16,536.
31 USC 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) willful violation of a foreign financial agency transaction requirement: USD 165,353.
Negligent violation of a foreign financial agency transaction requirement: USD 1,430.
FBAR-specific rows under 31 USC 5322 and the 5321(a)(5)(C)(ii) foreign financial asset row were not present in the chunks read, so no figure for them is published on this site.
sources.quote: paraphrase: $16,536 (non-willful), $165,353 (willful)

sources.title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
facts: Form 8938 thresholds for a taxpayer living in the United States: single, USD 50,000 on the last day of the year or USD 75,000 at any time; married filing jointly, USD 100,000 or USD 150,000.
Form 8938 and FBAR are separate requirements with different thresholds and forms.
Failure to file Form 8938 carries a USD 10,000 penalty, with up to USD 50,000 more after notice.
sources.quote: paraphrase: penalty of $10,000 ... up to $50,000

sources.title: Gifts from foreign person (Form 3520, Part IV)
facts: A gift or bequest from a nonresident alien or foreign estate must be reported on Form 3520 Part IV if the aggregate received from that person and related persons exceeds USD 100,000 in the tax year; each gift over USD 5,000 must be identified separately.
Threshold for purported gifts from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships: USD 20,116 for 2025 and USD 20,573 for 2026.
Due 15 April for a calendar-year taxpayer, 15 June for a citizen residing abroad, extendable to 15 October.
Penalties may apply under IRC 6039F(c) where there is no reasonable cause.
sources.quote: paraphrase: exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year

sources.title: Instructions for Form 2555 (2026)
facts: Foreign earned income exclusion requires a tax home in a foreign country and either bona fide residence for an uninterrupted period including a full tax year, or physical presence in a foreign country for at least 330 full days in 12 consecutive months.
sources.quote: paraphrase: physically present in a foreign country or countries for at least 330 full days

sources.title: Rev. Proc. 2026-35 (2027 inflation adjustments)
facts: Section 3.41: foreign earned income exclusion for tax years beginning in 2027 is USD 137,300.
Section 3.46(1): annual gift exclusion for 2027 is USD 20,000.
Section 3.51: the IRC 6039F threshold for reporting large gifts from foreign persons for 2027 is USD 21,240.31.
sources.quote: For taxable years beginning in 2027, the foreign earned income exclusion amount under § 911(b)(2)(D)(i) is $137,300.

sources.title: 26 USC 988 - Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
facts: Section 988(c)(1): disposing of nonfunctional currency is a section 988 transaction.
Section 988(a)(1): exchange gain or loss is computed and treated as ordinary income or loss.
Section 988(e)(2): the exclusion for personal transactions applies only to the first USD 200 of gain.
sources.quote: paraphrase: paragraph (2) shall apply only to the extent of the first $200 of gain

sources.title: CBP: Money and monetary instruments
facts: FinCEN Form 105 is required for currency or monetary instruments over USD 10,000 brought into or taken out of the United States.
Monetary instruments include coins and currency, traveller's checks, and bearer negotiable instruments.
Failure to report can lead to seizure and forfeiture and to civil and criminal penalties under 31 USC 5321, 5322 and 5317.
sources.quote: paraphrase: There is no limit on the amount of money ... however, if you are carrying more than $10,000 ... you must file FinCEN Form 105

sources.title: Foreign tax credit
facts: The foreign tax credit is available for foreign income taxes, war profits taxes and excess profits taxes paid or accrued.
No credit is allowed for taxes on income excluded under the foreign earned income exclusion.
sources.quote: paraphrase: You can't claim a credit for taxes on income you exclude

sources.title: Streamlined filing compliance procedures
facts: Available to individual taxpayers who certify that the failure to report foreign assets and pay tax was not willful.
Taxpayers under civil examination or criminal investigation are not eligible.
Certification of non-willful conduct is required; the procedures do not produce a closing agreement.
sources.quote: paraphrase: certifying that their failure to report foreign financial assets and pay all tax due ... did not result from willful conduct

sources.title: 中华人民共和国税收征收管理法 (Tax Collection and Administration Law)
facts: Article 32: late payment surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue tax per day from the date payment is due.
Article 52: where the taxpayer miscalculated, the tax authority may recover tax and surcharge within three years, extendable to five years in special circumstances.
Article 44: a taxpayer owing tax may be prevented from leaving China if the tax, surcharge or security is not settled.
sources.quote: 从滞纳税款之日起，按日加收滞纳税款万分之五的滞纳金
